value.title: Bounce the daemon after an rs merge
value.summary: After an rs merge: bring the main checkout up to date, rebuild and restart the daemon with `just bounce-rs`, and audit with `just doctor`.

value.who: Whoever merged a PR that touches crates/, or the prime.
value.when: After any PR that changes the daemon merges to main (the standing order). Run it with `--key <PR number>` so each merge is its own run.

value.text: this is the canonical main checkout on main
value.fix: run it from the main checkout (`just link` and the deploy recipes refuse linked worktrees)

value.title: Bring the main checkout up to origin/main
value.done_when: The canonical main checkout's HEAD is origin/main.

value.title: Rebuild, install and restart the daemon
value.done_when: The running daemon reports the main checkout's HEAD as its commit.
value.proven_in_practice: `just bounce-rs` is the fleet's standing order after every rs merge; this step wraps it unchanged.

value.title: Audit the installed surfaces
value.done_when: `just doctor` reports the daemon up and prints a fix for anything stale.

sections.name: done_when
sections.value: The daemon runs the merged code from the main checkout, and `just doctor` is clean or names its fixes.

value.text: The restart leaves a sub-second gap; clients reconnect. A failure after the old daemon is signalled has no rollback (AGENTS.md, release-build.sh).
A disruptive rehearsal: run it for real only after a merge, or rehearse at a quiet time (PRD 005 req-24).
Bouncing from a linked worktree: it would install that tree's build.
Building with bare cargo: bounce-rs builds through shared-build at niceness 19, one build at a time.
